line: Help someone reach something on a high shelf.
paragraph: Diane and Brian Johnsen live in Beaverton, Oregon. They are retired and had been facing financial hardship. A local contractor called Aviator installed a complete heating and cooling system in their home. The work and equipment were worth about sixteen thousand dollars. The couple paid nothing. They will endure the winter in comfort now. They say they have peace of mind.

seed.summary: An Oregon couple facing financial hardship can now endure the winter in comfort and with ‘peace of mind’ since a new HVAC system was installed in their home at no cost. Diane and Brian Johnsen of Beaverton received a complete heating and cooling system installed—valued at approximately $16,000—with the labor performed by local contractor Aviator
seed.sourceTitle: Retired Couple Surprised With New HVAC System Worth $16k in a ‘Feel the Love’ Program That’s Aided 3100 Folks
